title: Campaign Lifecycle
classification: SRS state names | SDD transition and closure rules proposed
summary: Vòng đời Campaign: nháp, hoạt động, hoàn tất, hủy và lưu trữ; tách việc chạy AI khỏi trạng thái chiến dịch.
notes:
Archive is not deletion.
Archiving M3 snapshots does not
automatically archive the Campaign.

title: Brand-Creator Relationship
classification: Core SRS relationship states | SDD transition guards proposed
summary: CRM cơ bản theo FE-07: SHORTLISTED → CONTACTED → COLLABORATING → COMPLETED; có nhánh không hợp tác.
notes:
The Brand records external interactions.
The system does not infer a reply,
acceptance or agreement automatically.

This machine tracks one relationship
within one campaign, not ShortlistItem membership.
Removing a shortlist item does not
erase collaboration history or create M1.

title: Collaboration and Outcome
basis: FE-08; UC39, UC41-44; FE-10; Registration section 4
classification: Core business lifecycle | State labels normalized for SDD; cancellation rules proposed
summary: Vòng đời hợp tác cơ bản; hoàn tất hợp tác, gửi review và xác thực dữ liệu học là các việc khác nhau.
notes:
Completion does not imply a review exists
or that historical evidence is validated.
Learning is requested separately after
Campaign completion and evidence validation.
Missing KPI or fee data remains unknown.

This is the basic recording workflow.
Content submission / approval states
are shown separately in appendix A1.

title: User Account Status
classification: SRS account status names | Suspension and restoration rules proposed
summary: ACTIVE, LOCKED, SUSPENDED theo phần màn hình quản trị; không trộn trạng thái đăng nhập vào vòng đời tài khoản.
notes:
Account status is separate from role,
email verification and login session state.
Locking or suspension should invalidate sessions
and retain campaign and audit history.

title: Creator Ownership Claim
classification: Registration requires claiming | Manual review states refined from current Java code
summary: Claim thủ công theo yêu cầu xác minh Creator của bản đăng ký; trạng thái và điều kiện được làm rõ bằng code hiện có.
notes:
The claim remains approved until revoked.
Ownership is not transferred by matching
an email, display name or social handle.

This is a manual Claim request, not an OAuth session
or an account-registration invitation.
A rejected/revoked request remains historical;
a later claim is a new request.

title: Brand Subscription
basis: UC47-49; Brand Plans / Upgrade; Registration section 4.1-2
classification: Document-led subscription lifecycle | Expiry and cancellation policy proposed
summary: Gói trả phí chỉ kích hoạt khi xác nhận thanh toán thành công; hết quota không đồng nghĩa hết hạn gói.
notes:
Quota exhaustion does not change status.
Quota and permissions are separate checks.
This design uses immediate cancellation;
the documents do not define the exact policy.

Renewal or upgrade creates a new subscription
under the applicable billing policy.
The old record is retained for history.

title: Subscription Payment
basis: UC47; Admin Transaction / Refund screens; Registration section 4.2
classification: SRS names: PENDING / SUCCESS / FAILED / REFUNDED | Refund rules proposed
summary: Thanh toán gói theo tên trạng thái trong SRS; retry tạo giao dịch mới, callback lặp không kích hoạt gói lần nữa.
notes:
A browser redirect alone is not payment proof.
Verify reference, amount and gateway authenticity.
Retry after FAILED creates a new Payment;
the previous transaction is not reset.

title: Creator Data Collection Job
basis: FE-04.5, FE-04.12-13; UC71-73; Admin Collection Job screens
classification: SDD job-state proposal | Retry, rate limiting and cancellation derived from document functions
summary: Job thu thập dữ liệu có retry/rate limit; lỗi refresh giữ nguyên snapshot hợp lệ trước đó.
notes:
A failed refresh must not erase or overwrite
the latest successfully collected Creator data.
Attempt history and errors remain traceable.

title: Recommendation Run
basis: FE-05.1-11; LI-12, LI-15; Recommendation Run Persistence
classification: Proposed execution lifecycle | No complete RecommendationRun implementation in this repository
summary: Vòng đời một lần chạy recommendation; các bước lọc/chấm điểm là hoạt động bên trong RUNNING, không phải trạng thái Campaign.
notes:
Missing M1 does not automatically reject a Creator.
Reflect missing evidence in confidence.
Never invent metrics, fees or outcomes.
No eligible candidate is a valid empty result,
not necessarily a technical failure.

title: Post-Campaign Learning Job
classification: Proposed learning-job lifecycle | Evidence policy and retry rules require SDD agreement
summary: Job học sau chiến dịch: thiếu bằng chứng thì chờ, chỉ sử dụng dữ liệu đã xác thực; không ghi đè Brand Profile bằng suy luận.
notes:
Missing evidence is not fabricated.
Do not require every optional KPI or review:
use validated facts that are actually available.

Learned M4 must not overwrite explicit Brand Profile.
Current M3 takes precedence over learned preferences.
Shortlisting or contacting alone never triggers learning.

title: Extended Collaboration: Content Approval
basis: Brand screens 22-23; broader than FE-08 core workflow
classification: OPTIONAL SRS SCREEN VARIANT | Not the implemented collaboration state machine
summary: Phụ lục: vòng đời duyệt nội dung từ phần mô tả màn hình; chỉ dùng nếu nhóm chọn phạm vi mở rộng.
notes:
Use this variant only if the team adopts
Creator-side submissions and content approval.
The core scope and exclusions do not consistently
include this workflow. It replaces diagram 03,
rather than adding states silently to its enum.

title: Extended Collaboration Invitation
basis: Brand screen 21; conflicts with EX-02 marketplace exclusion
classification: OPTIONAL SRS SCREEN VARIANT | Distinct from Creator claim or registration invitations
summary: Phụ lục: lời mời hợp tác theo màn hình; khác hoàn toàn lời mời claim kênh hay mời đăng ký Creator.
notes:
This is an offer to join a Campaign.
It is not creator.model.CreatorInvitation
(channel ownership claim) or
auth.model.CreatorRegistrationInvitation.
The three invitation lifecycles are separate.

Do not use this variant in the basic external-contact MVP.
The documents must first agree on in-platform acceptance.
